summary: An independent rerun of P-L4-007 on 299 figure labels reproduces all eight registered numbers to within one agreement (ZL3b exact 27 against a null of 24.8, p = 0.047 and 0.035; one glyph allowed 82 against 75.7, p = 0.019 and 0.020), and ZL's own clock marks put the three shared f73r/f73v labels two to three figure positions apart, so the one-place shift is not one label copied across the leaf but three words repeated at figures that do not correspond.
